info.title: Tavily Search
info.description: Tavily Search API - AI-optimized web search engine. Returns ranked results with titles, URLs, content snippets, and relevance scores. Use this to search for real-time information, news, and current events.

post.description: Search the web using Tavily's AI-optimized search engine. Returns clean, structured results perfect for LLM agents.

search_depth.description: Search depth: 'basic' (balanced, 1 credit) or 'advanced' (highest relevance, 2 credits).

max_results.description: Maximum number of search results to return (1-20).

topic.description: Category: 'general' for broad searches, 'news' for real-time news.

include_answer.description: Include an AI-generated answer summary for the query.
